I have learned that using improved seed together with manure and some chemical fertilizer gives much better maize yields on this land. My family will do most of the work, but since this plot is nearly two hectares, I will need to hire laborers from the village during planting and weeding season. I do not use pesticides or irrigation here because the rains are usually sufficient and maize does not need those chemicals.
